Finset.prod.{u_3, u_4} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [CommMonoid β] (s : Finset α) (f : α → β) : β
```
***
`∏ x ∈ s, f x` is the product of `f x`
as `x` ranges over the elements of the finite set `s`.

***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset*

```lean
Finset.prod_induction.{u_3, u_6} {α : Type u_3} {s : Finset α} {M : Type u_6} [CommMonoid M] (f : α → M) (p : M → Prop)
  (hom : ∀ (a b : M), p a → p b → p (a * b)) (unit : p 1) (base : ∀ x ∈ s, p (f x)) : p (∏ x ∈ s, f x)
```
***
To prove a property of a product, it suffices to prove that
the property is multiplicative and holds on factors.
